servicesSummary: Innovation Norway (aka Innovasjon Norge) Provided travel information, answered written, telephone, and email requests from travel trade. Sent travel information digitally to travel agents and tour operators, travel editors and freelance writers. Hosted travel webinars to inform travel trade about opportunities in Norway. Posted on Facebook/visitnorway and Instagram/visitiNorway pages.
